title: prunus domestica subsp. cerasifera
intro: Prunus domestica subsp. cerasifera, commonly known as cherry plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia and the Himalayas. The cherry plum is valued for its edible fruits, which are rich in various nutrients and offer several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of cherry plum include soothing digestive issues, relieving menstrual cramps, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of cherry plum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
